run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T07:12:16Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend is backed by error spans on the checkout path only: frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate is zero until the 07:12:16 point and then climbs to a peak of about 2.39 spans/s, while its non-error (UNSET) rate stays near 41-46 spans/s; the error spans are limited to POST, POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and the grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder client span. The failing trace shows frontend -> checkout PlaceOrder (gRPC 13, message 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500') -> checkout HTTP POST -> shipping /get-quote (error, 70 us) -> a shipping child span with operation 'POST ' failing in 10 us with 'Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))'; no quote, email or payment span exists in that trace. Deployment shipping was rolled out at 07:10:56-07:11:03 (new ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8, revision 2) with the same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping but a changed env var: QUOTE_ADDR went from 'http://quote:8080' (ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84, revision 1) to 'quote:0000'. After the rollout shipping's client span name changes from 'POST quote' to 'POST ' and the quote service's POST /getquote span rate falls from about 0.7/s to zero by 07:17, consistent with requests never reaching quote. The quote Service (port 8080) and its endpoint are present and no quote span appears in the failing traces, so quote is not the origin; the email message text is not corroborated by any email span, and email's own spans carried no error status while its traffic ceased once checkout stopped reaching it. All flagd flags are default 'off' and only the shipping Deployment carries an invalid address-style value, so the supported cause is the shipping Deployment's QUOTE_ADDR value introduced by its 07:10:56 revision.

claims.text: At the alert instant 2026-11-17T07:12:16Z, frontend had 0.237 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans/s versus 43.35 STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans/s (5-minute rates), and the 5-minute error-rate series for frontend is zero at every earlier returned point back to 06:46:16.
Frontend's error rate stays elevated through the end of the window: peak 2.385 spans/s at 07:18:16, 2.119 spans/s at 07:23:16 and 0.622 spans/s at the last point 07:25:16.

Frontend error spans are confined to the checkout flow: span_name POST, POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder become non-zero from 07:12:16, while GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, 'executing api route (pages) /api/cart', 'executing api route (pages) /api/data', grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and tcp.connect stay at 0.

Per-service STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rates rose together from 07:12:16 onward for frontend, frontend-proxy, checkout and shipping (e.g. checkout 1.185 and shipping 1.185 spans/s at 07:21:16), while payment and cart are 0 across every returned point and ad, fraud-detection and recommendation stay at a pre-existing ~0.0037 spans/s background level.

The elevated error span names are: checkout 'HTTP POST' and 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder'; frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress'; shipping '/get-quote' and 'POST ' — each at about 0.59 spans/s at 07:17:16 and still non-zero at 07:25:16.

In trace 4fb765cd7bb5a40b8b891b0898201055 the chain is load-generator user_checkout_single -> frontend-proxy ingress/router frontend egress -> frontend POST /api/checkout (http.status_code 500) -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (grpc.status_code 13, status description 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500') -> checkout 'HTTP POST' client span -> shipping '/get-quote' server span (error, 70 us) -> shipping child span operation 'POST ' (error, 10 us, status description 'Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))'); the trace contains no quote, email or payment span.
Deployment otel-demo/shipping currently sets env QUOTE_ADDR to 'quote:0000'.

The shipping Deployment has two ReplicaSets with the same container image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping: revision 1 shipping-75d58f5d84 (created 06:34:25, replicas 0) sets QUOTE_ADDR 'http://quote:8080', and revision 2 shipping-5ffdc77bc8 (created 07:10:56, replicas 1) sets QUOTE_ADDR 'quote:0000', so the 07:10:56 rollout changed configuration only, not the image.

Kubernetes events for the shipping rollout are: ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 SuccessfulCreate and Deployment shipping 'Scaled up replica set shipping-5ffdc77bc8 from 0 to 1' at 07:10:56; pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started at 07:10:56-07:11:03; pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q Killing and ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 SuccessfulDelete plus 'Scaled down replica set shipping-75d58f5d84 from 1 to 0' at 07:11:03.

Of all 21 otel-demo Deployments, only shipping carries a malformed address value (QUOTE_ADDR 'quote:0000'); other addresses are well formed, e.g. checkout SHIPPING_ADDR 'http://shipping:8080' and EMAIL_ADDR 'http://email:8080', cart VALKEY_ADDR 'valkey-cart:6379', ad FLAGD_HOST 'flagd'.

Shipping's client span for its quote call is named 'POST quote' until 07:15 and 'POST ' (empty target) from 07:17 onward, while quote's POST /getquote span rate falls from about 0.70 spans/s at 07:12 to 0 at 07:17; shipping's '/get-quote' server span rate stays near 0.6-0.7 spans/s through 07:25, i.e. shipping keeps serving while its outbound call no longer reaches quote.

The quote Service exists with port 8080 and a ready endpoint (100.96.4.18:8080), and the shipping and email services/endpoints are likewise present, so this is not a missing Service/endpoint condition.

The shipping pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn is Running with 0 restarts, its log shows repeated 'Requesting quote' lines after the rollout, and its events show a normal Started sequence rather than any crash, eviction or probe failure.

The change to Deployment otel-demo/shipping (env QUOTE_ADDR 'quote:0000', new ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 at 07:10:56) is the object that applied the fault: immediately after it, shipping's outbound quote POST fails with InvalidUri(InvalidFormat), /get-quote returns an error, checkout PlaceOrder returns gRPC 13 and frontend POST /api/checkout returns HTTP 500, raising frontend's error rate above zero from the 07:12:16 point.

Affected entities with their own failure evidence: frontend (http.status_code 500 on POST /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with grpc.status_code 13), frontend-proxy (http.status_code 500 on ingress and router frontend egress), checkout (oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error with status description 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500' and its 'HTTP POST' client error span) and shipping (/get-quote error span and 'POST ' InvalidUri span). load-generator's own POST spans also recorded http.status_code 500 as the client view of the same failing checkout requests.

Hypothesis that the quote service failed was rejected: the failing trace contains no quote-service span, shipping's outbound POST fails locally in 10 us with InvalidUri(InvalidFormat), quote's Service/endpoint exist and quote's POST /getquote span rate (about 0.7 spans/s) simply stops after shipping stops calling it.

Hypothesis that the email service is the failing dependency (as the propagated error text 'failed POST to email service' could suggest) was rejected: no email span appears in the failing traces, email's returned span series carry only STATUS_CODE_UNSET (no error status) and email's request rate falls from about 0.7 spans/s to 0 only after checkout requests start failing, which is consistent with checkout failing before its email step rather than with email returning errors.

Hypothesis that a flagd feature flag injected the fault was rejected: the flagd-config ConfigMap lists every flag with defaultVariant 'off' (including paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, cartFailure, productCatalogFailure, adFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage) and there is no shipping quote flag; payment's error rate is 0 throughout.

Calls observed inside the same failing traces other than shipping were healthy: cart (POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, HGET), currency (Currency/Convert, otel.status_code OK, rpc.grpc.status_code 0) and product-catalog (oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, rpc.grpc.status_code 0) returned success, and payment's error-span rate is 0 across the window.

Restore Deployment otel-demo/shipping's QUOTE_ADDR to a valid quote URL (the previous revision used 'http://quote:8080', matching Service quote port 8080) in the Helm values/source that produced revision 2 and roll the Deployment, then confirm shipping's client span again shows a 'POST quote' target and that quote receives POST /getquote traffic.

Add a pre-deployment validation for URL-style environment variables such as QUOTE_ADDR, SHIPPING_ADDR, EMAIL_ADDR and CART_ADDR so an unparseable value like 'quote:0000' fails the rollout instead of shipping to production.

gaps: The change-history integration is not available in this Run, so which actor or tool applied the shipping Deployment change at 07:10:56 (Helm upgrade, GitOps sync or manual edit) could not be verified; only the object state and the rollout events were observed.

list_prometheus_rules returned no rule (no_data) for rule_name RequestErrorRate and for type=alert, so the alert's exact PromQL expression and the meaning/unit of its 'current: 1.7777777777777777' annotation value could not be verified.

The propagated error text names 'email service' ('shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500') while the child span that failed is shipping's outbound POST with InvalidUri(InvalidFormat) in 10 us and no email span exists in those traces; whether the shipping image's message is mislabeled could not be verified from the available evidence.
The previous shipping pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q no longer exists and its previous container logs are unavailable, so there is no pre-rollout shipping log baseline to compare against.
fetch_pod_logs on frontend-675fd7b5c5-lmznt returned no lines for the incident window, so frontend application log text could not be used to corroborate the 500 responses.

For currency, product-catalog, quote, email, kafka and image-provider the per-service STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate query returned no series at all, so their error counts from that metric are unknown rather than zero; quote, email, currency and product-catalog were only assessed through sampled spans and traffic-rate series.
Whether the alert cleared after the authorized window end 2026-11-17T07:25:57Z is unknown, since no data beyond that time was authorized or queried.
A baseline for comparing frontend latency before and after the rollout was not established, so no latency claim is made.
next_steps: Review the Helm release/values source (release otel-demo) for the shipping service and the audit trail of the 07:10:56 revision to identify who set QUOTE_ADDR to 'quote:0000'.

After the environment value is corrected, verify recovery by checking that shipping's quote client span target is non-empty again, quote's POST /getquote rate returns to about 0.7 spans/s, and frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate returns to 0.
Confirm the alert rule RequestErrorRate's expression in the Alertmanager/Prometheus rule configuration so its threshold and the unit of the reported 'current' value are documented.
